title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Azan 2002 views Q. I am from India & presently working in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I follow the Hanafi maslak. Sometimes due to work related travel I mis the jamat of Zohar salah. But I try to reach the masjid at the earliest to perform my Zohar salah. But sometime it happens that when I reach the masjid I find that Asar Jamat (as per Hambali timing) has started. But as per Hanafi salah timetable I still have time for our Zohar salah, as Asar time has not started as per Hanafi timetable. Now my question is what should I do? Do i read the Zohar salah first & then try to join the jamat of Asar which has already started may be the jamat may be over before I complete my Zohar salah. or I directly join the jamat for Asar salah & read my Zohar after that? I am very confused. But this happens only sometimes may be once in 3-4 months. 3561 views Q. Is Namaz-e-Fajir ka waqt kab tak rehta hay awr kaysay check kray gay. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 21790 Country: United Kingdom Title: i wanted to ask that if i miss a rakat behind the immam.then when do i pray thanna.will it be in the rakat which i pray after immam has done salaam or in the rakat as soon as i join jamat? Question: SALAMS, i wanted to ask that if i miss a rakat behind the immam.then when do i pray thanna.will it be in the rakat which i pray after immam has done salaam or in the rakat as soon as i join jamat? Answer ID: 21790 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 581/581/M=1431) When you stand to complete your missed rak'at after Imam has said salam then you would recite sana . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
